name: Shobab (son of Caleb and Azubah)
title: Son of Caleb from the tribe of Judah
summary: Shobab was a son of Caleb (son of Hezron) and his wife Azubah. He is mentioned in the genealogies of Chronicles as part of the tribe of Judah. Shobab is primarily known through his family connections and plays a role in the genealogical records that link the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Judah
keyEvents.description: Shobab is mentioned as one of the sons of Caleb (son of Hezron) with his wife Azubah in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Caleb's family and descendants
keyEvents.description: In connection with the listing of Caleb's descendants, Shobab is mentioned along with his brothers Jesher and Ardon as sons of Azubah.

keyEvents.title: The Death of Ashubah and Caleb's New Marriage
keyEvents.description: After Ashubah's death, Caleb married Ephrath, who bore him Hur. This provides context for Shephatiah's family situation.

keyEvents.title: Hezron's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Shephatiah is part of the important genealogical line from Hezron, son of Perez, son of Judah, which leads to King David and ultimately Jesus Christ.
